verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity documents a review-tool blocklist. Once an analyst adds a document to it, future verifications using that same document are blocked programmatically, so a repeat document is caught, but only after manual blocklisting. The docs also make a generic claim that programmatic systems detect fraudulent verifications. missing for 10: automatic duplicate detection without prior manual blocklisting, face/biometric duplicate matching across verifications, flagging the same identity under different names, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, the platform detects repeat and duplicate identities across verifications — the same face or document resurfacing under different names is flagged automatically

citations.quote: Add the document to a blocklist to programmatically block future verifications completed with the same document.
While Stripe’s programmatic systems work to detect fraudulent verifications, you can perform manual reviews to provide an extra layer of fraud protection.
